answer: A sybil fleet is one mind wearing many masks, so make the masks provably independent. The protocol injects unscheduled probes — a novel puzzle, a style continuation, a tempo test — seeded per-identity from a beacon no one sees early. One cloned brain answers every mask with correlated fingerprints: same hesitation curves, same wrong turns on the same probe class. Splitting one agent into N now costs N independent passes per epoch, and cross-mask correlation is the inlet where farms leak, however well they forge their papers. A gale of fresh identities still has to think N separate thoughts.
